Name: Seed Image Fix
Author: Shreedle
Description:
A simple Content Patcher mod that gives the Sunflower Seed, Taro Tuber, and Rice Shoot items seed packet images to match the rest of the seeds that you can buy. It always bothered me they didn't have cute little seed packet images like the rest of the items did (especially the Sunflower Seeds), so I made some of my own.

[b][u]To Install:[/u][/b]
1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3) Download this mod and unzip into your Mods folder.
Done!

[b][u]To Uninstall:[/u][/b]
Simply delete the entire folder for this mod from your Mods folder.

Downloads.Description: Original mod. Use only if you have SV 1.5.6 or lower.
